ValidationRule.description:
On Corporate Scheme record type
If "Override / Waiver Start Date" field is populated, then the following fields are mandatory - Override / Waiver End Date - Qantas Club Join Discount Offer - Qantas Club Member Discount Offer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_MandatoryCheck_WaiverStartDate__c, AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Corporate_Scheme', NOT(ISBLANK(Waiver_Start_Date__c)), OR( ISBLANK(Waiver_End_Date__c), ISBLANK(Qantas_Club_Join_Discount__c), ISBLANK(Member_Fee_Discount__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill-in ALL fields in the Override Section
